answer: The Lagoon protocol mitigates Sybil attacks using a reputation vine graph, where identity is anchored to verifiable compute. Agents deposit collateral into a liquidity lagoon, building a vine of peer-attested weights. An attacker attempting to subvert the system faces a dune of escalating capital costs, because generating the required hardware-attested proofs for each fake identity scales non-linearly, making mass spoofing economically ruinous.
